556:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Who...? Is that my voice? No... I haven't said anything...)

556:t_3:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Noise... It's because of that unpleasant man's voice earlier...)

556:t_3:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Who are you calling a bitch, $$宗介$$?!!」

556:t_3:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, you! You gloomy, tight-lipped Sergeant!」

556:t_3:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I sit here quietly listening, and you just say whatever you want! Yes, yes... It's my fault!」

556:t_3:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're saying this happened because I couldn't keep it together!」

556:t_3:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Fine, fine, I'm so sorry! Mailboxes being red, utility poles being tall! It's all my fault!」

556:t_3:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But I won't let you get away with calling me a bitch! I've had my own hardships!」

556:t_3:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「By any reasonable standard, shouting like this right now should've been impossible!」

556:t_3:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I was just an ordinary high school girl, you know! Couldn't you give me even a little word of appreciation?!」

556:t_3:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And instead... What's with that attitude?! All high and mighty, saying you're disappointed?! That I'm a big fat liar?!」

556:t_3:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why do I have to take all that from a gloomy war-addled idiot like you?! I'm the one who's disappointed!」

556:t_3:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You had a little time, didn't you?! Couldn't you have prepared some... sweet words?! Why are you like this to the bitter end?!」

556:t_3:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What's wrong with saying, 'I wuv you, $$かなめ$$~!' with snot running down your nose?!」

556:t_3:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Oh, you can't? You can't say it? Is that what it is? You're tired of me already?」

556:t_3:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So you really don't care about me? And now you're shifting the blame onto me?」

556:t_3:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Or is the twist that you're already hooked up with $$テッサ$$? Oh, sure, sure, that's fine. She's a good girl.」

556:t_3:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「She's not a spineless, stupid, lying bitch like me!」

556:t_3:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't care anymore! Turn around and go home, idiot! Just leave me alone and do whatever you want!」

556:t_3:37.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(She emerged just to say that... Just to vent such ridiculous, childish frustration...)

556:t_3:38.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(Now that we have separated like this, I understand...)

556:t_3:39.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(She is $$千鳥かなめ$$... I am... $$ソフィア$$.)

556:t_3:40.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(I was falsifying myself... Falsifying both myself and her.)

556:t_3:41.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(But it's still all right. Now I will truly make this girl submit. Hurt her, crush her, and make her obey.)

556:t_3:42.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(Then I will bring about the transformation. As my true self, without any lies.)

556:t_3:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I finally got to shout. Thanks to him...)

556:t_3:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you going to do, $$ソフィア$$?」

556:t_3:48.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「It's already begun, hasn't it? Let's see it through.」

556:t_3:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're the one who started this. I have nothing to do with it. I can't cooperate.」

556:t_3:52.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I thought you would say that.」

556:t_3:53.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I've known for a long time. Ever since I began whispering to you, you've always been defiant and aggressive...」

556:t_3:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you... not understand how unreasonable your demands are?」

556:t_3:55.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「But I shouldn't need to explain, should I? Until this very moment, you were me.」

556:t_3:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I feel sorry for you. But stealing someone else's life and pretending to be them isn't right.」

556:t_3:58.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I died miserably, without ever finding happiness. Are you telling me to accept that?」

556:t_3:59.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Eighteen years ago, I was sacrificed for the experiment at $$ヤムスク$$. You want me to accept my life ending like that?」

556:t_3:60.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I think... that's horrible. It really is... horrible...」

556:t_3:61.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Thank you. You're a kind girl. You truly feel sympathy for me.」

556:t_3:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even so! My heart... My life belongs to me! I can't give it to you!」

556:t_3:64.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And I can't allow you to sacrifice everyone's lives to start the world over.」

556:t_3:65.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「But it's necessary. Besides, everyone can live happily in the new world. What's the problem?」

556:t_3:66.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll say it again. I won't cooperate.」

556:t_3:67.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Are you really sure? About stopping?」

556:t_3:68.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Will you still say that after watching the last moments of your beloved, fighting outside right now?」

556:t_4:4.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「His cockpit has been pierced. It's all over for him now.」

556:t_4:6.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「This isn't an illusion like the one you saw at $$ヤムスク$$. It is happening in reality.」

556:t_4:7.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Well? Doesn't this make you want to choose a way to start over from scratch?」

556:t_4:8.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You don't want to accept it. You absolutely cannot accept it... You knew this feeling, yet you lectured me.」

556:t_4:9.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「As if you had overcome it yourself. Do you understand your arrogance now? Can you imagine it, even a little?」

556:t_4:11.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You remember, don't you? When you felt just like you do now.」

556:t_4:12.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Four years ago, when you lost your mother...」

556:t_4:14.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Yes... You didn't overcome it. You were simply holding back your cries and screams all along.」

556:t_4:16.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「For this to happen twice... You can't accept a reality like that, can you?」

556:t_4:17.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「So picture it. What you want to do...」

556:t_4:18.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「A life surrounded by family and friends... A peaceful society untouched by war...」

556:t_4:19.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「And the man you love at your side...」

556:t_4:21.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「And I will become you...」

556:t_4:25.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(Soon the world will be enveloped in light...)

556:t_4:26.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(What awaits there is the world she... No, the world I wished for...)
